title: XCAPE proposes nine previously unmatched crystal structure assignments
summary: In an arXiv preprint, researchers used XCAPE and the SevenNet-Omni machine learning interatomic potential to revisit existing powder X-ray diffraction patterns. In the subset without matching reference structures, they reported nine plausible atomic arrangements, eight halides and one sulfide, that met diffraction and energy criteria. These are inferred structural assignments from existing measurements and computed energies. The preprint does not establish that the assignments are unique or independently confirmed.
organization: Seoul National University; Korea Institute for Advanced Study

evidence.tested: Existing powder diffraction patterns were compared with predictions, using an energy criterion to assess plausibility. The nine assignments are the subset reported in Section 2.5.
evidence.unknown: Unique assignment and independent experimental confirmation were not established in the reviewed preprint.
evidence.ai_role: SevenNet-Omni evaluated energies and relaxed candidate structures during the evolutionary search, supporting selection of candidates for comparison with measured diffraction.

source_review.scope: arXiv v1 abstract, Section 2.5, validation and methods
